The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Azimabad P.S. Case No. 92 of 2023 for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 379, 427, 307, 498A, 504, 506/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2.

As agreed between the parties, the matter is referred to the Mediation and Concilliation Center,
Patna High Court, Patna where petitioner as well as O.P. No. 2 shall appear in person on 24.02.2025.

3. Put up this matter on 25.03.2025 along with the report of Mediation and Concilliation Centre,

4.
During pendency of this application, the interim Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.44771 of 2024(5) dt.06-02-2025 relief granted to the petitioner shall continue.

(S. B. Pd. Singh, J) prabhakar/-
